Blocks whose promise types come from CFEngine Build modules. Adding one adds its module to the project; saving installs it with `cfbs`. The module runs with Python, so hosts need `python3`.

## Git Checkout

Clones a git repository into a folder and keeps it at a branch, tag or commit.

**Generates:** a `git` promise.

**Module:** `promise-type-git`, added to the project with the block.

### Settings

| Setting                   | Required | Description                                                                                               |
| ------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Folder**                | Yes      | Where the repository is cloned, e.g. /srv/app. Needs git on the host.                                     |
| **Repository URL**        | Yes      | E.g. https://github.com/cfengine/starter_pack. A private one needs credentials for root (gitcredentials). |
| **Branch, tag or commit** | Yes      | E.g. main or master: the git module can't follow the remote's default branch unnamed.                     |
| **Keep it updated**       | Yes      | One of: **Yes: pull new commits**, **No: clone once**. Default: **Yes: pull new commits**.                |
| **Local changes**         | Yes      | One of: **Keep them**, **Discard them**. Default: **Keep them**.                                          |
| **History depth**         | No       | Empty: the full history. 1: the latest commit only. At least 1.                                           |

### Example

The policy it generates, for example:

```cf3 {skip}
# Clone the app
git:
  "/srv/app"
    repository => "https://github.com/cfengine/starter_pack",
    version => "main",
    update => "true",
    force => "false";
```

## HTTP Request

Sends an HTTP(S) request, e.g. to download a file or call an API.

**Generates:** an `http` promise.

**Module:** `promise-type-http`, added to the project with the block.

### Settings

| Setting                  | Required | Description                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **URL**                  | Yes      | Starting with https:// or http://.                                                                                                   |
| **Method**               | Yes      | One of: `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `PATCH`. Default: `GET`.                                                                     |
| **Save the response to** | No       | Empty: the response is dropped (an OK status keeps the promise). The request runs on every agent run: set How often, or a condition. |
| **Headers**              | No       | One per line, Name: value.                                                                                                           |
| **Body**                 | No       | Sent as is; @/some/path sends a file.                                                                                                |
| **Server certificate**   | Yes      | One of: **Checked**, **Not checked (insecure)**. Default: **Checked**.                                                               |

### Example

The policy it generates, for example:

```cf3 {skip}
# Download the logo
http:
  "https://cfengine.com/images/cfengine-logo.svg"
    method => "GET",
    file => "/var/www/html/logo.svg",
    insecure => "false";
```

## Run Ansible Playbook

Runs an Ansible playbook on the host (connection local by default).

**Generates:** an `ansible` promise.

**Module:** `promise-type-ansible`, added to the project with the block.

### Settings

| Setting            | Required | Description                                                                                   |
| ------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Playbook**       | Yes      | Its absolute path on the host, e.g. /srv/ansible/site.yml. Needs Ansible on the host.         |
| **Inventory**      | No       | The inventory file or host list, e.g. /srv/ansible/hosts. Empty: Ansible's default inventory. |
| **Tags**           | No       | Only the plays and tasks with these tags, one per line.                                       |
| **Limit to hosts** | No       | Hosts or groups, one per line.                                                                |
| **Become**         | Yes      | One of: **No**, **Yes (sudo)**. Default: **No**.                                              |
| **Become user**    | No       | Empty: root.                                                                                  |

### Example

The policy it generates, for example:

```cf3 {skip}
# Run the site playbook
ansible:
  "/srv/ansible/site.yml"
    tags => { "web" },
    become => "false";
```

## Systemd Unit

Keeps a systemd service running or stopped, and can write its unit file.

**Generates:** a `systemd` promise.

**Module:** `promise-type-systemd`, added to the project with the block.

### Settings

| Setting                  | Required | Description                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Service name**         | Yes      | E.g. myapp (myapp.service).                                                                                                                      |
| **State**                | Yes      | One of: **Running**, **Stopped**, **Removed (with its unit file)**, **Restarted on every run**, **Reloaded on every run**. Default: **Running**. |
| **Start on boot**        | Yes      | One of: **Yes**, **No**. Default: **Yes**.                                                                                                       |
| **Reload systemd first** | Yes      | daemon-reload before acting, e.g. after a unit file changed outside this block. One of: **Yes**, **No**. Default: **No**.                        |
| **Description**          | No       | Setting any unit field below writes the unit file (/etc/systemd/system/<name>.service).                                                          |
| **Start commands**       | No       | ExecStart, one per line, e.g. /usr/bin/myapp --port 8080.                                                                                        |
| **Type**                 | No       | One of: **Default (simple)**, **simple**, **forking**, **oneshot**, **notify**.                                                                  |
| **Run as user**          | No       | The user the service runs as. Empty: root.                                                                                                       |
| **Restart**              | No       | One of: **Never**, **On failure**, **Always**.                                                                                                   |
| **Start after**          | No       | Units, one per line, e.g. network-online.target.                                                                                                 |

### Example

The policy it generates, for example:

```cf3 {skip}
# Run my app
systemd:
  "myapp"
    state => "started",
    enabled => "true",
    daemon_reload => "false",
    unit_description => "My app",
    service_exec_start => { "/usr/bin/myapp --port 8080" },
    unit_after => { "network-online.target" };
```
